subject: Aaron Olapade School Committee Candidacy
overview: School Committee candidate Aaron Olapade presented his qualifications and platform to the community ahead of the November election.

items.title: Aaron Olapade Candidacy Statement
items.summary: Aaron Olapade outlined his unique qualifications for the School Committee, highlighting his perspective as a recent graduate of color, his professional experience as a community liaison, and his mentorship of at-risk youth.
